sentences.text:
The instant appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed on behalf of the appellant seeking the following reliefs:
"a) Allow the present Appeal and set aside/modify/rectify the Judgment and Award dated 09.11.2023 passed by Ms Mayuri Singh, Ld.

PO MACT EAST- DISTRICT:
Karkarduma Courts, Delhi in MACP no. 42I/2019 titled as "Sh. Rakshit Singh (injured) Vs Sh. Krishan Pal & Ors"

entities.text: Rakshit Singh (injured) Vs Sh. Krishan Pal & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
b) Pass such other/further order(s) as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the interest of justice."
2. Heard.
3.
Issue notice of the appeal and the accompanying application to the respondents through all permissible modes on filing PF within one week.
4. This Court is of the considered view that the matter requires consideration.
5. Subject to the appellant depositing the entire compensation amount This is a digitally signed order.
